description: This Java class 'EntityAutoEngine' implements a service engine for entity operations such as create, update, delete, and expire within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles dynamic entity management based on service parameters, including primary key handling, validation, and related business logic.

classes.name: EntityAutoEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that provides entity operation services such as create, update, delete, and expire, with logic for primary key handling and validation.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides runSyncIgnore to call runSync, ignoring the return value.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Main method executing create, update, delete, or expire operations based on service parameters, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: invokeCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of new entity instances, including primary key generation, validation, and setting audit fields.

methods.name: invokeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating existing entity instances, including validation, status change checks, and audit fields.

methods.name: invokeDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of entity instances based on primary key lookup.

methods.name: invokeExpire
methods.description: Handles expiring (setting thruDate) of entity instances, with date validation.

methods.name: isValidText
methods.description: Validates security-related text parameters to prevent injection or invalid data.
